requirements.quote: Seen 2026-11-27 on an external repo: lanes added *.sh scripts without +x.
Fix (generic, in the lane's own pre-PR check, so it does not depend on repo CI):

For files the lane adds or modifies, a file with a shebang, or a *.sh that a workflow, script or package.json invokes directly (`./path.sh` or `path.sh`, not `bash path.sh`), must be mode 100755 in the index (`git ls-files -s`).
The builder fixes it with `git update-index --chmod=+x` / `chmod +x`.
A mode regression (+x removed) is also caught.
Relation: with PR CI off for staging (#6150), lane-side checks of what repo CI would catch matter more.
requirements.why: follow: context only; the gate runs lane-side without repo CI

deliverables.change: New pure detector execBitFindings({git, base, readFile, listFiles}): for files changed base..HEAD (git diff --raw --no-renames, mode column) report {path, kind:'missing-x'|'regression', why} when mode is 100644 and (file starts with #! shebang, or is *.sh referenced directly as ./path.sh or path.sh, not preceded by bash/sh/source, in .github/workflows, scripts, package.json, Makefile) or when base mode was 100755 and head is 100644. Skips deleted files, symlinks (120000), and test fixtures. Also exports applyExecBits({git, findings}) running `git update-index --chmod=+x` (and the chmod on disk) for missing-x and regression findings.

node:test cases: added shebang file at 100644 flagged; *.sh invoked ./x.sh in a workflow flagged; `bash x.sh` caller not flagged; 100755 -> 100644 regression flagged; already-100755 and non-script clean; applyExecBits issues update-index --chmod=+x.
Add io.execBits({cwd, base}) and io.execBitsFix({cwd, findings}) wrapping execbit.mjs with the lane git runner, next to io.duplicateExports (effects.mjs:749).

Add execBitGate(trigger) beside duplicateGate (lean.mjs:3307-3330), called at hand-off before the PR: findings -> mechanical fix via io.execBitsFix, commit, re-detect; leftovers -> one builder fixRound with execBitsPrompt, then an anomaly (never blocks). Honors vcfg.execBits !== false and isSplit. Emit EXEC_BIT_FINDINGS event and T.decisions line.
Add execBitsPrompt(findings, mode) next to duplicateExportsPrompt (prompts.mjs:73): lists paths, tells the builder to run git update-index --chmod=+x / chmod +x and commit.
Parse verify.exec_bits (false only for literal `false`, like duplicate_exports at verify.mjs:88) into vcfg.execBits.
Assert verify.exec_bits default on and false turns it off.
Gate case: a lane adding a 100644 shebang script gets it fixed mechanically and committed with no builder round; unfixable leaves an anomaly; vcfg.execBits false skips.
Add entry documenting the exec-bit gate (#6239), its opt-out verify.exec_bits, and what it flags.
